purpose: Targeted checks for ADR-046 (28.09.2026): a condition in the evidence that changes what the person pays or receives (a price cap, the person's own share, a threshold, the municipality's share) must reach the answer, across different benefits and services, not only the hearing aid of acceptance C9. Written before any run; each turn is run on the code before and after the change.

expectation_help.evidence: each regular expression matches the title of a source the search gave the model
expectation_help.must: regular expressions on the visible answer text

turns.text: Ema kuulmine halveneb ja pensionist ei jätku kuuldeaparaadi ostmiseks. Kust alustada?
